title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Mock Exam #2

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #2
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is a healthy way to calm down when you feel angry? (1 mark)
   A. Take deep breaths and count to ten
   B. Shout at everyone
   C. Break things
   D. Hit the person

2. Which choice affects other people besides yourself? (1 mark)
   A. Choosing your favourite colour
   B. Choosing which shoe to wear first
   C. Littering the school compound
   D. Choosing a song you like

3. A friend invites you to skip class and play. What is the best choice? (1 mark)
   A. Leave school
   B. Politely say no and go to class
   C. Tell the teacher a lie
   D. Join him secretly

4. Which Bible passage tells children to obey their parents in the Lord? (1 mark)
   A. John 3:16
   B. Genesis 1:1
   C. Ephesians 6:1-3
   D. Luke 1:37

5. Who are your grandparents? (1 mark)
   A. Your brothers
   B. The parents of your mother or father
   C. Your uncles
   D. Your neighbours

6. Why should Christians respect their bodies? (1 mark)
   A. Because it is fashionable
   B. Because they are proud
   C. The body is a temple of the Holy Spirit
   D. Because of money

7. What does it mean to revere God? (1 mark)
   A. To forget Him
   B. To respect Him deeply and be in awe of Him
   C. To fear Him only
   D. To ignore Him

8. Which of these is an attribute of God taught in this topic? (1 mark)
   A. Unknown
   B. Forgetful
   C. Weak
   D. Sole Creator

9. Which is a poetry and wisdom book in the Old Testament? (1 mark)
   A. Joshua
   B. Isaiah
   C. Psalms
   D. Exodus

10. Which New Testament book tells how the early church began? (1 mark)
   A. Luke
   B. Hebrews
   C. Acts
   D. Romans

11. Which of these is an honest use of money? (1 mark)
   A. Stealing from a friend
   B. Lying about the price
   C. Cheating in a game
   D. Returning extra change to a shopkeeper

12. What is the meaning of "bless" in this story? (1 mark)
   A. To ignore
   B. To curse
   C. To speak good things over someone
   D. To insult

13. Who had the dreams about seven cows and seven heads of grain? (1 mark)
   A. Potiphar
   B. Pharaoh
   C. Jacob
   D. Joseph

14. What did God tell Abram to do? (1 mark)
   A. Go to Egypt
   B. Build a boat
   C. Leave his country and go to a land God would show him
   D. Stay at home

15. Where did John preach? (1 mark)
   A. In Antioch
   B. In Egypt
   C. In Rome
   D. Near the River Jordan

16. How many men with leprosy met Jesus? (1 mark)
   A. Five
   B. Two
   C. Ten
   D. Twelve

17. What is revenge? (1 mark)
   A. Hurting someone because they hurt you
   B. Sharing
   C. Praying
   D. Forgiving

18. In the parable, who does the woman stand for? (1 mark)
   A. A shopkeeper
   B. A priest
   C. A sinner
   D. God

19. Which of these helps God's kingdom grow? (1 mark)
   A. Keeping quiet
   B. A good example and sharing the good news
   C. Being unkind
   D. Ignoring church

20. What does the mustard seed stand for? (1 mark)
   A. A big city
   B. The end of the world
   C. The small beginning of God's kingdom
   D. A rich king

21. Which of these is a trusted person at school? (1 mark)
   A. A person who offers gifts
   B. Someone who asks for secrets
   C. Your class teacher
   D. A stranger at the gate

22. What is a lie? (1 mark)
   A. A prayer
   B. A true story
   C. A false statement told to deceive
   D. A song

23. What did Jesus say to the disciples about the children? (1 mark)
   A. Wait for tomorrow
   B. They are too small
   C. Send them away
   D. Let them come to me

24. Who did the disciples rebuke? (1 mark)
   A. The children
   B. The people bringing children
   C. The Pharisees
   D. The soldiers

25. What does Luke 16:10 teach? (1 mark)
   A. Be greedy
   B. Money is evil
   C. Do not work
   D. Whoever is trusted with little can be trusted with much

26. How should you care for an exercise book? (1 mark)
   A. Leave it in the rain
   B. Draw on it
   C. Cover it and keep it clean
   D. Tear it

27. What does the word apostle mean? (1 mark)
   A. A king
   B. One who is sent
   C. A fisher
   D. One who sits

28. Who was Andrew's brother? (1 mark)
   A. Thomas
   B. John
   C. Philip
   D. Simon Peter

29. What is a warning sign of an unsafe group? (1 mark)
   A. It tells you to keep secrets from parents
   B. It welcomes you kindly
   C. It encourages school work
   D. It teaches good manners

30. What should you do if someone offers you a harmful drug? (1 mark)
   A. Hide it
   B. Say no, walk away and tell a trusted adult
   C. Sell it
   D. Try it

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. State three qualities of good giving. (3 marks)

32. Give three reasons why children should not join ungodly groups. (3 marks)

33. Give three ways of turning away from sin and living righteously. (3 marks)

34. Describe how Zacchaeus met Jesus and how his behaviour changed. (4 marks)

35. Explain how the parable shows God's love for the sinner and how a child can respond. (5 marks)

36. Give two words that describe Joseph's character in this story. (2 marks)

37. Describe what Jesus did to raise the widow's son. (3 marks)

38. Explain why Joseph said, "I cannot do it, but God will give Pharaoh the answer". (3 marks)

39. Describe three steps you can follow to forgive someone. (3 marks)

40. Explain why the body is called a temple of the Holy Spirit. (3 marks)

41. Give two reasons why the birth of Jesus is unique. (2 marks)

42. List three activities Christians do in church. (3 marks)

43. State three reasons why we should pray every day. (3 marks)

44. Explain how we can prevent the spread of contagious diseases and how we should treat those who are sick. (5 marks)

45. Give three steps you can follow to make a right choice. (3 marks)

46. Name two things that can defile the body. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #2 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Take deep breaths and count to ten
   Slowing down helps you to think before acting.

2. C — Littering the school compound
   Littering makes the compound dirty for everyone.

3. B — Politely say no and go to class
   Skipping class is wrong and harms learning.

4. C — Ephesians 6:1-3
   Ephesians 6:1-3 tells children to obey and honour their parents.

5. B — The parents of your mother or father
   Grandparents are the mothers and fathers of your parents.

6. C — The body is a temple of the Holy Spirit
   1 Corinthians 6:19 gives this reason.

7. B — To respect Him deeply and be in awe of Him
   Reverence is deep respect for God.

8. D — Sole Creator
   God is the sole Creator, loving Father and holy.

9. C — Psalms
   Psalms, Proverbs and Job are among the poetry and wisdom books.

10. C — Acts
   The Acts of the Apostles tells the story of the early church.

11. D — Returning extra change to a shopkeeper
   Honesty means returning what is not ours.

12. C — To speak good things over someone
   To bless is to ask God's good for someone.

13. B — Pharaoh
   Genesis 41 says that Pharaoh had the dreams.

14. C — Leave his country and go to a land God would show him
   Genesis 12:1 records the call.

15. D — Near the River Jordan
   John preached in the wilderness by the Jordan.

16. C — Ten
   Luke 17:12 says ten men met Him.

17. A — Hurting someone because they hurt you
   Revenge is paying back harm.

18. D — God
   The searching woman stands for God's love.

19. B — A good example and sharing the good news
   We help by our life and words.

20. C — The small beginning of God's kingdom
   God's kingdom began small.

21. C — Your class teacher
   Teachers help keep children safe.

22. C — A false statement told to deceive
   A lie is not true and is told to deceive.

23. D — Let them come to me
   Matthew 19:14 records His welcome.

24. B — The people bringing children
   They told off those who brought the children.

25. D — Whoever is trusted with little can be trusted with much
   Faithfulness in small things matters.

26. C — Cover it and keep it clean
   Covers protect books.

27. B — One who is sent
   Apostles were sent out with a message.

28. D — Simon Peter
   Simon Peter and Andrew were brothers.

29. A — It tells you to keep secrets from parents
   Secrets from parents are a warning.

30. B — Say no, walk away and tell a trusted adult
   Refuse and seek help.

SECTION B
----
31. (3 marks)
   Answer: Cheerful, quiet, respectful, useful.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid quality.

32. (3 marks)
   Answer: They lead to wrong; they can harm us; they pull us from God and family; they ask for secrets.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

33. (3 marks)
   Answer: Say sorry to God; be honest; be kind; obey parents; pray and read the Bible.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

34. (4 marks)
   Answer: Zacchaeus climbed a tree to see Jesus. Jesus called him by name and went to his house. Zacchaeus promised to give half his goods to the poor and to repay four times anyone he had cheated.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for climbing the tree, 1 for Jesus calling him, 1 for giving to the poor, 1 for repaying.

35. (5 marks)
   Answer: God searches for lost people like the woman for her coin. He is happy when a person repents. A child can respond by saying sorry to God, turning away from wrong, living a righteous life, and caring for others who go astray.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for God's search, 1 for God's joy, 1 for saying sorry, 1 for righteous living, 1 for caring for others.

36. (2 marks)
   Answer: Wise, honest, humble, faithful, hardworking, trusting in God. Any two.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid word.

37. (3 marks)
   Answer: He felt compassion, told the woman not to cry, touched the bier and told the young man to get up.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for compassion, 1 for touching the bier, 1 for the command.

38. (3 marks)
   Answer: Joseph knew that wisdom comes from God. He was humble and did not boast. He gave God the honour.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for wisdom from God, 1 for humility, 1 for honouring God.

39. (3 marks)
   Answer: Calm down; think about what happened; talk to the person kindly; say I forgive you; pray.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid step.

40. (3 marks)
   Answer: The Holy Spirit lives in believers, so the body is holy like a temple and should be treated with respect.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Holy Spirit, 1 for holy, 1 for respect.

41. (2 marks)
   Answer: Conceived by the Holy Spirit, announced by an angel, He is the Son of God and Saviour.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: Pray, sing, read the Bible, give offerings, listen to the sermon, fellowship.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: We can thank God; ask for help; grow spiritually; know God better; get strength to avoid wrong.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

44. (5 marks)
   Answer: Wash hands with soap, keep the environment clean, eat well, visit the clinic and follow the advice of health workers. We should treat the sick with care, kindness and respect and not reject them, as Jesus did.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for hygiene, 1 for clean environment, 1 for clinic advice, 1 for kindness, 1 for not rejecting the sick.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: Stop and think; ask if it agrees with God's word; think about who is helped or hurt; pray; ask a trusted adult.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid step, up to 3.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: Alcohol, drugs, harmful media, sex outside marriage.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.
